name: Wakatsuki Ryuutarou
source:
The school's doctor. Wakatsuki-sensei is rather like a student than a doctor. He loves alcohol, cigars and beer. He likes to tease the character and sometimes views her as "impossible" but he helps her anyway. He is also a bachelor although he can't walk the character home as often as the others. He is always seen with a pony tail and head phones.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Otometeki_Koi_Kakumei_Love_Revo!!#Male_Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
